title: Mockaroo Field Type
description: Metadata describing one built-in Mockaroo field type as returned by /api/types.

name.description: Display name of the field type.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the field type generates.

category.description: Catalog category (e.g. Name, Internet, Address, Business, Date, Money, Geographic).

parameters.description: List of configurable parameters for this field type.
